_readme: Fill this in before resetting the live Redis finisher counters to 0 for a new race. baseOffsets carries over the all-time totals from before the reset, so counters keep reporting correct 'ever' numbers. specialFinishes lists all-time totals to flag when reached. See finisher-counters-config.example.json for a filled-in example. This file itself can stay all-zero/empty if you don't need carry-over or milestones.
